labels.notes: Camera-captured Python code printout for stochastic differential equations. Coupled_SDE simulations, matplotlib plotting, quadratic variation. Physically CRUMPLED/WRINKLED paper. Dark wood surface at bottom. Readable code despite paper damage. Uneven illumination from creases.

Camera-captured IEEE LaTeX IEEEtran class formatting document, page 25. Two-column dense technical text. \phantom, \vspace, IEEEeqnarray examples. Multiple equations (12a-14b). Grayish faded text typical of camera captures.

Camera-captured English research paper about adversarial attacks on image compression. Two-column. FGSM, PGD attack methods. Section IV with dense mathematical formulas. L_p distance metrics. Moderate fading.

Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra textbook page 32. Jordan canonical form problems (#15-20). Dense matrix notation, Hadamard matrices, eigenvalue proofs. Clean well-printed text. Slight page curl but good overall quality.

Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra textbook page 38. Hadamard inequality, determinant problems, Ostrowski/Brauer theorems. Dense math with summation formulas. Shadow at right edge from page curl. Footnote about Hadamard (1865-1963).

Camera-captured Chinese research proposal about dense pedestrian detection. YOLO series, single-stage vs two-stage detectors. Clean typed Chinese text. Paper slightly curled at edges. Moderate fading on text.

Camera-captured English academic questionnaire about research methods. 5 questions: research skills, online databases (IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, Arxiv, WoS, DOAJ), research niche example (Qian Xuesen). Clean typed text, well-structured, minor fading.

Camera-captured Chinese scientific/philosophical document about civilization evolution, AI, deep learning, quantum computing, nanotechnology, biological engineering. Very dense typed text. Finger visible at left edge. Moderate fading.
